There are over 80+ charms in the Lingango modpack, this wiki page categorizes these charms not only when in progression these can be found, but how they affect the user when equipped. There are 5 main categories:
Base Cooldown Reduction(note: Cooldown reduction on items and weapons from the mod Aquamirae is a different start)

None of the Relics/Artifacts are Progression Locked, unlike armor or weapons. Meaning in theory, most Relics/Artifacts are attainable pre-Boss, for the sake of this overview, we'll be looking at the Relics/Artifacts from the point of view when they could reasonably be acquired. While you can acquire Relics/Artifacts such as the Pearl of the Void pre-Iron Colossus, it is not reasonable to expect such.
* Means that while reasonably obtainable, not recommended cause of the RNG associated with getting the charm.
